title: 18434 - 18434/P2002/008194
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G450) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G450)

Diesel Particle Filter (DPF)
Gerçekleştirin: Emergency Regeneration (Refer to Specifications!)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Diesel Particle Filter (DPF)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Diesel Particle Filter (DPF)
technicalNotes:
Skoda Superb (3U) & VW Passat (3B) (Engine Codes: BGW, BSS, BWW) had issues with faulty Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleris (G450), they were defective from factory and due to a leaking sealing the measured values were incorrect and resultet in wrong calculated particle filter load and unsuccessful regeneration cycles.
With CBEA and CJAA engines, the factory documentation may show the wrong part location for the Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri 1 (G450).  This sensor is in a foil pouch just behind the oil cap.
